text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria takes the lead!
The leader is Gran Alegria!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

Gran Alegria shifts up another gear.
Her light, effortless footwork almost makes it look easy.

Graceful and supple like a gentle breeze.
Gran Alegria stormed past the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria takes 1st! So strong!
A fierce, beautiful queen is born right here!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"To think that existing race data
would truly be... useless..."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm constantly evolving,
every single day!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Still, if it's Chrono-chan,
she'll probably make her prediction with that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. The 'Genesis Method'
will definitely conquer Gran-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Heheh, not gonna let you!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Gran Alegria!
You were seriously strong out there!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That was a beautiful run!
You truly are the Queen of the Cherry Blossoms!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this feels so good!
Happy 120 miles♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Give me more and more of your cheers, everyone!
(WOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: If I do say so myself, that was the best run of my life!
It was a race that truly demonstrated a league of her own. Everyone undoubtedly felt that she was cut from a different cloth.

She wasn't exhausted this time and is still full of energy after the race.
If she builds up her stamina, in the future, even medium distances—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: So, I'm entering the Oaks next!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I'm going to race Love-chan. I promised her!
choice_data_list: The Oaks is 2,400 meters, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's medium distance, right? So while I'm at it, I'll become a two-division champion!
choice_data_list: No, no, no... Let's think this through calmly.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You saw how I ran today, right?
I can definitely win at 1.5 miles too!

Gran Alegria refused to back down an inch.
It seemed having a discussion right here would be difficult...
choice_data_list: ...Could you give me some time to consider it?
...Could you give me some time to consider it?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right. You need time to think over
training plans and such, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Then let's consider it once we get back!

The next day, during morning class hours,
I consulted with Master regarding the next race.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Talk about a high-class problem.
I guess that's the kind of trouble you run into when you're too talented.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
All jokes aside, we need to properly convince them.
I will attend the discussion as well.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Make sure you prepare a next target race
that can convince Gran."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Is your concern that
we don't have much time until the Oaks, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
True, I haven't trained for medium distances, but...
lately my stamina's been building up bit by bit, too.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Judging by how it felt to run the Oka Sho,
I think I can win the Oaks too!"
choice_data_list: No. There's a much bigger problem here.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Like what?
choice_data_list: It's because your body still isn't fully developed yet.
Because your body isn't fully developed yet.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Gran is still midway through her physical maturation.
Her muscle mass and build are overwhelmingly insufficient.
choice_data_list: I think it's still too tough to run middle distance.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Growth spurts can make things unstable.
For instance, as your strength increases, your stride length changes.
Which means the feel of your running changes quite a bit too.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Try running a Medium distance you're not suited for in that condition.
Your entire running form could completely fall apart.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ! ...A total collapse...
choice_data_list: If it collapses, you might not be able to put it back together, you know?

text_block_list.text:
"If that happens, you could become more prone to injury,
or even completely unable to win."
Which means... it could even impact her racing career as a whole.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Unable to break free from a losing streak...
there were girls in the past whose spirits broke completely.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Your racing career is still far from over.
With talent like Gran's,
you're sure to set all kinds of records.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
More than the victory right before your eyes...
I want you to cherish your future.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: My... future...!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And guiding you to a better future—
is the Trainer's job.
choice_data_list: How about the NHK Mile Cup for your next race?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "The NHK Mile Cup—that's 1,600m at Tokyo Racecourse, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: I see, Rhein Kraft, huh.
choice_data_list: Yes. We're aiming for the irregular Double Crown.

text_block_list.text:
The unorthodox double crown of the Oka Sho and the NHK Mile Cup.
It was a racing rotation first blazed by Rhein Kraft.
Back when almost every Umamusume on the Tiara route proceeded to the Oaks, entering the NHK Mile Cup caused quite a stir.
You could truly say she paved the way for sprinter and miler Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: "Not proceeding to the Oaks—that choice carries a message of its own."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: A deeper message?

A race that can truly convince her...
There's no other proof to rely on than this—!
choice_data_list: Show them that Triple Crown Umamusume aren't the only strong ones!
Show them that Triple Crown Umamusume aren't the only strong ones.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ! I see, the strongest on the mile...!

Because she possesses talent surpassing even historical Triple Crown Umamusume,
there is true meaning in running the NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Rather than the Triple Crown, I want to be the undisputed Mile Champion—
And because it's me, I can prove it!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: That sounds infinitely thrilling to the max!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: The road to the strongest isn't just the Oaks! I want to prove that to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I want to run in the NHK Mile Cup!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
It's decided, then.
I'm just glad Gran didn't push herself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...
For me, '8 Mile' really hit home.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just about winning the race.
You were thinking about my future too, weren't you!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So that I can keep running safely,
for a long, long time—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Because I want to keep running too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "I'll be in your care for the NHK Mile Cup!"
